source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 979 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 979 was established by Ordinance No. 30290, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 14, 2016. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 979 is established on property located along the southwest line of Carroll Avenue, southeast of Worth Street. The size of PD 979 is approximately 1.373 acres. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 979A: development plan. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 979A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District only by specific

use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MF-2(A) Multifamily District apply.

(b) Side yard.

(1) Except as provided in this paragraph, minimum side yard along the northwest property line is 10 feet. Minimum side yard of five feet is required for structures and parking within 124 feet of Alcalde Street along the northwest property line.

(2) No minimum side yard is required along the southeast property line.

(3) Except as provided in this subsection, retaining walls with a maximum height of 28 inches and required parking may be located in required side yards.

(c) Height.

(1) Maximum height. Except as provided in this subsection, maximum structure height is 50 feet

(2) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Except for chimneys, structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less. Chimneys may project through the slope to a height 12 feet above the slope and 12 feet above the maximum structure height. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.109. FENCES.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the fence regulations for the MF- 2(A) Multifamily District apply.

(b) Materials.

(1) Except as provided in this section, new fences shown on the development plan must may not exceed six feet in height and be made of wrought iron or similar materials, including tubular and hollow materials that appear like wrought iron.

(2) Existing fences shown on the development plan must be made of the materials listed on the plan.

(c) Fence height and location. Fences are only allowed in the locations and heights shown on the development plan. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) Off-street parking shown on the development plan may be located in the front yard.

(c) The screening provisions for off-street parking in Section 51A-4.301(f) do not apply in this district. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.113. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) Building identification markers existing on December 14, 2016, including the identification of the school, are not considered signs. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 30290)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-979.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 30290)
